status_sections.Summary: Unagi 21.0.2 is the worst release RAG at Red, with 1 open item and 1 open blocker. The single biggest risk is the backlog of 18 open blockers/criticals, including 17 escalations, with 164 total open issues and 10 net new issues in the last 30 days.
status_sections.Risks & slips:
- Unagi 21.0.2 is Red with 1 open blocker: SPEC-5676.
- Vimba 22.0.0 is Green, but it still has 2 open issues: SPEC-5672 and SPEC-5673.
- master is Green, but it still has 5 open issues: SPEC-5585, SPEC-5586, SPEC-5672, SPEC-5673, and SPEC-5688.
- SPEC-4693, SPEC-4963, SPEC-5487, SPEC-5444, SPEC-5468, SPEC-5483, and SPEC-5561 are long-lived blockers and are all in escalation.
- SPEC-5625, SPEC-5700, SPEC-5701, SPEC-5705, and SPEC-5713 are open blockers with no assignee and are in escalation.
- SPEC-5375 is the only open critical and is in escalation.
- Hygiene remains poor: 158 issues have no fix version, 100 have no component, 50 have no assignee, and 150 are stale.
status_sections.Asks / decisions needed:
- Assign an owner for SPEC-5625, SPEC-5700, SPEC-5701, SPEC-5705, and SPEC-5713.
- Confirm whether SPEC-5676 is the release blocker for Unagi 21.0.2 and what the release decision is.
- Review whether SPEC-5375 should be treated as the top technical risk given it is the only open critical.
- Decide how to reduce the 17 escalations currently active.
status_sections.Next steps:
- Triage the 18 open blockers/criticals and confirm status on each key.
- Clean up hygiene on issues with no fix version, no component, no assignee, and stale issues.
- Recheck release readiness for Unagi 21.0.2, Vimba 22.0.0, and master after blocker review.
- Track progress against the 24 versions complete but not released.
